title: BGPv6 Neighbor configuration on config_db not generated to frr.conf
author: Ezrickd
body:
bgp neighbor at 2019 image from March is creating frr config for ipv6 afi neighbor atatement.
when moving to newest image BGP ipv6 unicast neighbor statement is not created.

checking at BGP container I see that there are new folders :
At BGP Docker it is pointing to /usr/share/sonic/templates/bgpd/templates/general/instance.conf.j2

when on erlier build it was all on /usr/share/sonic/templates/

my configuration is simple.

       "2001:0:0:0:192:168:0:74": {
            "asn": "3230003333",
            "holdtime": "10",
            "keepalive": "3",
            "local_addr": "2001:0:0:0:192:168:0:75",
            "name": "t1s9003_p20",
            "nhopself": "0",
            "rrclient": "0"
        },
root@sonic-01:~# show ipv6 bgp summary
% No BGP neighbors found

when running older version like March 201911 image it works,..

You don't need to build any image
Just donwload file https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/b6c395c864bcb12b688fb120661544a1c7da8fa1/src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd and put it into bgp container instead of the old one
```
docker cp bgpcfgd bgp:/usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd
```

Fixes: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4572

**- Why I did it**
One ipv6 address could be represented in many ways. We must convert all incoming ipv6 addresses in one canonical way of the representation.

**- How I did it**
I convert ipv6 address to the canonical way before I saved it in the bgpcfgd.

**- How to verify it**
Build an image, run on your dut. create bgp_ipv6 neighbor which is not canonical, for example "fc02:0000:0000::1
And check that bgpcfgd created session "fc02::1"
